steps.title: Know your root state
steps.description: This light tells you whether root is available. Root-gated modules show their own badge when it isn't.

steps.title: On-device model
steps.description: The local model's health and download state live here. Tap to jump straight to the Machine Learning dashboard.

steps.title: Provider health
steps.description: Green/amber/red per AI provider. Tap one to see latency; long-press to move it first in the failover chain.

steps.title: Your console
steps.description: Everything any module prints lands in the Terminal — with View, Download, and Clear controls in the header.
